entities.summary: John Chilembwe Uprising 1915, a transformative movement in Malawi (1915–1915). Emerged from Chilembwe Uprising 1915 and British Central Africa Protectorate. Catalyzed Central African Federation and Federation of Rhodesia and Nyasaland.
